notes.title: Update 1.2.2 - BIG Festival 2021 Finalist! (and minor fixes)
notes.notes:
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Ex1913iWgAM__Sb?format=jpg&name=medium

We are proud to announce Cartomante was listed as a finalist in the "Best Brazilian Game" category for BIG Festival 2021, LATAM's biggest independent games event! 

BIG will happen from May 3rd to the 9th, and you can register here!

We also did some minor quality of life fixes:

- Fixed UI anchors in the pause menu;
- Removed the possibility of the pause menu bugging out by repeatedly pressing the escape key.
